title: 3 courses. One happy wallet.
description: A drink, starter, and entrée in one meal.
terms: 3 for Me starts at $10.99. Price depends on location and entrée. Premium selections cost more. Confirm your restaurant’s menu before ordering.

title: Your go-to meal deal
description: Sandwich, nuggets, fries, and a drink.
terms: Choose McDouble or McChicken. Prices and participation vary. Delivery excluded.

title: Dinner is better together
description: Two entrées and an appetizer to share.
terms: Meal for two. Check the selected restaurant for available entrées, exact price, and participation.

title: A better start for $2
description: An eligible breakfast sandwich in the app.
terms: Once weekly through October 4, 2026. Rewards enrollment required. Participating locations, breakfast hours only; tax and delivery excluded.

title: Fries on the side. On them.
description: Medium fries with a qualifying purchase.
terms: Once weekly through October 4, 2026. $1 minimum before tax. Rewards required; participating restaurants, no delivery.

title: Your next café favorite
description: Explore offers in your MyPanera account.
terms: No public deal price was verified. Choose your café and sign in to see any offers available to you. This listing is not a confirmed discount.

title: Ten nuggets, a little extra.
description: A 10-piece nugget offer with another purchase.
terms: Rewards account and app required. Buy another item to unlock $1.99 nuggets; total spend exceeds $1.99. Participating U.S. locations, limited time. Confirm eligibility and final price in the app.

title: Take $3 off your order.
description: A digital offer for a qualifying $20 purchase.
terms: Requires a qualifying purchase of $20 or more and the digital offer. Check eligible items, fees, exclusions, expiration and participating location in the Wendy’s app. Cannot combine offers.

title: Small prices. Plenty of choice.
terms: Official menu lists items from $1.39 to $2.99. This is a value menu, not a coupon. Local pricing, availability and tax may differ; confirm with your selected restaurant.

title: Carry out a pizza night.
description: A large one-topping pizza carryout offer.
terms: Select the Weeklong Carryout offer. Carryout only; participating stores. Prices can be higher at some locations. Selected crusts, toppings and sauces cost extra; specialty and XL pizzas excluded. Limited time.

title: Two picks. One dinner plan.
description: Choose two or more qualifying items.
terms: Select Mix & Match. Two-item minimum; advertised minimum subtotal is $13.98 before tax, delivery and upgrades. Some stores charge more. Eligible items and prices vary by location.

title: Wings for the table.
description: Twenty bone-in wings, large fries and four dips.
terms: Limited-time advertised bundle at participating locations. Availability, pricing and delivery charges vary. Confirm with your selected restaurant.

title: Six-dollar comfort food.
terms: Limited time at participating U.S. restaurants. No substitutions or combining discounts. Tax and gratuity excluded. Prices may vary, including Alaska and Hawaii. Confirm eligible items and serving hours locally.

title: A different sub every day.
terms: Official menu advertises a $4.99 Sub of the Day. Sandwich selection depends on the day. Confirm size, participating location, additions, tax and final price before ordering.

title: Make it a meal.
description: Explore the advertised Meal of the Day.
terms: Official menu advertises a $6.99 Meal of the Day. Confirm the day’s selection, included items, participating location, additions and final price before ordering.

title: Breakfast with member perks.
terms: Membership required. Personalized offers and their prices are not independently verified. Confirm your own account’s offers, qualifying purchases and expiration. This listing is excluded from price-based deal alerts.
